description: Interface describing an edge between two vertices in an auditable item graph.

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the element was created.

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the element was modified.

dateDeleted.description: The date/time of when the element was deleted, as we never actually remove items.

targetId.description: The target vertex id the edge connects to.

annotationObject.description: The JSON-LD annotation object for the edge.

edgeRelationships.description: The relationships between the two vertices.
